name: WI-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Gwen Moore running for reelection
Polymarket prices Moore at 97% to win
Challenger Tim Rogers has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Milwaukee-based WI-04 is a D+26 seat with an entrenched incumbent, and prediction markets price Moore near certain to win. With no polls or expert ratings available, the fundamentals-based margin of roughly 27 points stands.
model.watch: Any surprise polling showing a single-digit race, or a major outside spending push for Rogers, would be the first sign this is closer than fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Gwen Moore seeks another term in a Milwaukee-centered district that leans heavily Democratic, with a partisan advantage of about 26 points. She has raised over $1 million for the race, while Republican Tim Rogers reports no fundraising activity, and an independent candidate is also on the ballot. Prediction markets give Moore roughly a 97 percent chance of winning.

No public polls or expert race ratings are available for this contest, so the forecast relies on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the fundraising gap. The expected margin is about 27 points, with uncertainty elevated because direct polling evidence is absent.
